structural_checks_passed: Nonempty reviewer identity and UTC timestamp
Exactly 121 unique IDs matching the instrument in original order
Allowed verdict and exact per-label schema for every case
String field and nonempty explanation for every case
permitted_review_inputs: Labelling rubric supplied in the delegation prompt
prohibited_review_inputs: Checker and scorer implementations or tests
Prior findings, adjudications and comparison results
Repository history, wiki, memory and other documentation
rubric_clarification_supplied_before_lab: Insufficient or missing evidence is cannot_tell with an explanation, not zero or proof that a claim is false. This explicitly extends the rubric's stated ambiguous-reading example to unavailable evidence; retain this disclosure when interpreting the labels.
procedure: Adjudicate all 121 highlighted figures using only their notes and supplied evidence.
Record a verdict, attributed field and case-specific reasoning for every case.
Parent validates schema, coverage and provenance without revising substantive labels.
Preserve delivered labels in a local commit before opening the key or scoring.
Any later reconciliation is separate; original labels are not overwritten.
limitations: AI adjudication, not human ground truth or measured inter-rater agreement.
The parent reviewer has seen prior findings; they were not forwarded to the fresh-context labeller.
Blinding is a fresh-context and input-restriction procedure, not an operating-system access restriction.
The finite historical frame excludes claims not extracted by the checker; this review does not audit those omissions.
